title: Data and code for: Understanding the Collapse of the South Pacific Hake (Merluccius gayi gayi)
description: Data and code of the manuscript "Understanding the Collapse of the South Pacific Hake (Merluccius gayi gayi)" (Ecological Applications, EAP25-0808). Population-dynamics models (Verhulst-Royama reproductive curve with lateral and vertical exogenous effects, and a prey model for jumbo squid predation) fitted to the stock-assessment biomass of South Pacific hake, 1968-2020. The repository holds the data, the R and Python code, all the candidate models of each period and their selection, the figures and the fits to the assessment cases and to the acoustic-survey biomass. The code is under the MIT License and the data and outputs produced by the authors under CC BY 4.0.
